vaporwave: Style: vaporwave aesthetic — pastel pink/purple/cyan palette, chrome grids, retro 80s computer graphics vibe, glossy reflective materials, soft gradient skybox.
noir: Style: film noir black-and-white — high contrast, hard directional shadows, fog volumetrics, monochrome materials with subtle warm key light.
